prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) proved helpful (+4.4% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests while 3 showed no clear effect.
Home redesigns (home, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow) were helpful (+4.2% average after noise correction), winning 1 test while 1 showed no clear effect.
Choose path redesigns (choose_path, redesign) were helpful (+2.9% average after noise correction), winning 1 test while 1 showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally too low for winning tests and consistently too high for tests showing no clear effect or performing poorly.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +4.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +7.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -8.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -7.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.4% after noise correction, 6 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 75.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive pet playstyle preference flow: Adds an interactive playstyle choice flow after picking a pet to customize desktop behavior. (why: Adoption has a 75.2% completion rate with a mean time of 1017s, and users reported confusion around pet behavior.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet generation waiting screen: Moves the sign-in step to occur right after the pet generation waiting screen before home intro. (why: Reordering sign-in steps showed a +4.4% win rate historically, letting users engage deeply before account creation.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Desktop compatibility check screen before photo upload: Inserts a system compatibility check screen prior to custom pet photo upload. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures and 3 reported pets not rendering on desktop.)
3: [home, wait_info] Real-time generation progress updates on waiting screen: Adds an animated progress bar and step-by-step render status timer on the waiting screen. (why: Home step waiting time is long (median 201s / mean 2336s), leading to user dropoff while waiting.)
4: [sign_in, incentive] Account sign-in benefit highlight badge: Adds a badge highlighting cloud backup for pet progress on the sign-in screen. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after re-signing into the app.)
5: [adoption, copy] Photo lighting and resolution guidance copy: Updates the photo upload screen body text with clear lighting and single-subject framing instructions. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or incorrect model outputs.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Estimated onboarding time callout on path selection: Displays a short time estimate hint under the main headline on the choose path screen. (why: Users take a mean of 514s on choose_path, indicating hesitation without time expectations.)
7: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive sound selection preview flow in adoption: Adds an audio sample picker component allowing users to preview pet vocalizations before finalizing adoption. (why: Adoption stage has a 75.2% completion rate and users spend significant time (mean 1017s) choosing pet options.)
